text.text: Active while wearing at least one piece (the effect itself does not stack): Iron's Spells mana, this mod's curse power and Goety souls cover each other - when one pool falls short, the others are drawn on in a fixed order.
Mana shortfall: curse first, then souls. Soul shortfall: curse first, then mana. Curse shortfall: souls first (the pre-existing rule), then mana.
Rates: 1 mana = 4 souls, 1 curse = 3 souls (so 1 curse = 0.75 mana). The resources are really spent, not faked - with all three pools empty the spell still fails.

effects: All three pools cover each other, honestly spent
